description: This file defines OAuth scope constants, hierarchy, and utility functions for handling scopes in the GitHub MCP Server project.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Type representing a GitHub OAuth scope, with associated constants and methods.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Scope.

methods.name: GetAcceptedScopes
methods.description: Returns all scopes that satisfy the given required scope, including parent scopes.

methods.name: ScopeIncludes
methods.description: Checks if a scope includes another scope, directly or through hierarchy.

methods.name: HasRequiredScopes
methods.description: Checks if a set of scopes satisfies all required scopes.

methods.name: ScopeStrings
methods.description: Converts a slice of Scope to a slice of strings.

methods.name: ParseScopes
methods.description: Converts a slice of strings to a slice of Scope.

methods.name: WithScopes
methods.description: Returns a map with OAuth scopes to be used in mcp.Tool Meta.

methods.name: GetScopesFromMeta
methods.description: Extracts OAuth scopes from an mcp.Tool Meta field.
